description: This file defines the 'ProjectUser' result class for the Coocook schema, representing the association between projects and users, including roles and ownership transfer logic.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::ProjectUser
classes.description: A Moose-based ORM class representing the 'projects_users' join table, managing project-user relationships and roles.

methods.name: make_owner
methods.description: Transfers ownership of a project to a user with admin role, demoting previous owner and updating project ownership within a transaction.
